info.title: Handi API
info.description:
The Handi app API (What to Cook). Everything lives under `/api/v1`.

**Auth** — sign up (`POST /auth/register`) or log in (`POST /auth/login`) to get a Sanctum token, then send
`Authorization: Bearer {token}` and `Accept: application/json` on every request.

**Errors** — 422 has `{message, errors{field:[...]}}` with the exact copy the app shows; 401 = token missing or revoked;
429 = rate limited (180/min signed in, 60/min guest, 20/min on auth routes; login lockout returns `retry_after`).

**Dates** are the user's local date (`Y-m-d`, timezone from the account, default Asia/Karachi). Timestamps are ISO-8601.

A ready-made Postman collection is in `docs/handi-api.postman_collection.json`, and the full written guide in `docs/api.md`.

get.description: The global library users pick their kitchen from during onboarding. Cached; admin edits apply on the next request.
Popular cities plus every city grouped by province.
Today's weather for a city or coordinates, bucketed into hot / mild / cold / rainy.

post.description: Runs the real picking rules on a guest's choices before they sign up. Nothing is saved.

Creates the account together with everything chosen during onboarding:
family & budget, preferences, location, at least 10 dishes and any custom dishes.

Five wrong passwords lock this email (from this IP) for 60 seconds.
Wrong password → 401 with `attempts_left`; locked → 429 with `retry_after`.
Revokes this phone's token and stops reminders on it.
Always 202. Includes the masked email, how long the code is valid and when it can be resent.
429 with `retry_after` if asked again within 45 seconds.

Returns a `reset_token` for “Set new password”. Wrong code → 422 with `attempts_left`;
after 5 wrong codes → 429 (request a new code).

message.const: Too many attempts. Request a new code to try again.

post.description: Logs the account out on every phone.

get.description: The signed-in user with kitchen settings, location, reminder and counts.

patch.description:
Changing the email needs `current_password`; a 6-digit code is emailed to the new
address and the change applies after `POST /me/email/verify`.

delete.description: Needs the password and the word DELETE. Removes the user and all their data.

post.description: The 6-digit code sent to the new address.

patch.description: Send any of the fields. Changes apply from tomorrow's picks.

put.description: `{mode:"city", city_id}` or `{mode:"gps", lat, lng}` (rounded to ~1 km). Returns the kitchen and today's weather there.

get.description:
Everything the Today tab needs: weather, the 3 picks (first = top pick), shuffles left,
the planned dish, today's log from the picks, stats and when the next picks arrive.
`stage` is pick | planned | done.

post.description: Up to 5 times a day. 429 when none are left.

put.description: Plans one of today's picks for lunch or dinner. Nothing is logged yet.

get.description: Filter by `q` (name) and `category` key; `custom=1` for custom only.
Includes library defaults, overrides, last cooked and when it can be suggested again.

patch.description: For library dishes this stores your own tags; "Reset to library tags" undoes it.

delete.description: It won't be suggested anymore; past history stays. Undo with `POST /me/dishes/{id}/restore`.

examples: Custom dishes have no library tags.

post.description: Multipart field `photo`, image up to 10 MB. Adds a "Photo added" notification.
JSON or multipart (with optional `photo` up to 10 MB). `weather` is an array, e.g. ["rainy","mild"] or ["any"].

weather.description: One or more of hot, mild, cold, rainy — or just any. Multipart: weather[]=cold&weather[]=rainy

photo.description: Optional image up to 10 MB (send as multipart/form-data)

weather.description: One or more of hot, mild, cold, rainy — or just any. Multipart: weather[]=cold&weather[]=rainy

delete.description: Past meals with this dish stay in history. Undo with restore.

get.description: `month` = YYYY-MM (default: this month). Meals grouped by day, plus "{n} of {days} days logged".

post.description:
`id` may be a client UUID (offline queue) — sending the same id twice is safe.
If the same dish is already logged for that date and meal, the existing entry is kept:
200 with `meta.duplicate = true`.
post.summary: Log a meal / Mark as cooked

id.description: Optional client UUID (offline queue) — resending the same id is safe

date.description: Y-m-d, today or up to 60 days back
Y-m-d, today or up to 60 days back

delete.description: Undo with restore within the snackbar window.

get.description: Days logged in a row and meals this month.

post.description:
Replays meals logged or deleted while offline. Each operation:
`{op: "meal.create", payload: {id, kitchen_dish_id, date, meal, source}}` or `{op: "meal.delete", payload: {id}}`.
Results come back in the same order.
Upserts by `device_id` and links it to this login, so logging out stops reminders on this phone.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
